entities.summary: Vyacheslav Valentynovych Uzelkov, nicknamed "Steel Power", was a Ukrainian boxer. He competed at the 2001 World Amateur Boxing Championships, winning the bronze medal in the heavyweight event. He also competed at the 2002 European Amateur Boxing Championships, winning the silver medal in the same event.
